NX-8400 process controller

A sixteen-loop controller for continuous processes, rated for panel temperatures to 60 °C and certified for SIL 2 duty without an external safety module.

From £4,180 per unit

Request a quote

Specification

AttributeNX-8400
Control loops16 independent, 8 cascaded
Scan time5 ms typical, 12 ms worst case
Safety ratingSIL 2 without external module
Panel temperature-20 °C to 60 °C

What is in the box

  • NX-8400 controller with terminal covers
  • Field wiring loom
    • Sixteen analogue pairs
    • Four relay outputs
  • Commissioning licence for Northwind Studio

Fitting it to an existing panel

The NX-8400 uses the same DIN footprint and terminal ordering as the NX-8200 it replaces, so an existing loom can be transferred without re-terminating. Where a panel was built for the 8100 series, a carrier plate is available that keeps the original drilling.

We swapped forty-two controllers over three weekend shifts and did not stop the line once.

Maintenance manager, tier-one automotive supplier
